[1/3] Plan: close ADR-007 deferral. Lock file <store>.lock (O_CREAT|O_EXCL, pid+timestamp, one fsync), wait 3s / stale 30s per PRINCIPLE-013; transaction() contextmanager = acquire, load, yield, save on clean exit, release always; all five mutators refactor onto transaction (input validation stays lock-free, not-found raises inside the with so no spurious save); injectable lock_wait/retry_delay/stale_after for fast tests; save stays an unlocked primitive

impact_assessment.why: ADR-007 deferred locking until a second process appears; stats --json and agent/script usage now make concurrent CLI invocations realistic
impact_assessment.benefits: lost-update window between simultaneous commands is closed; lock is advisory, zero cost on the normal path
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new .lock file beside store, mutators semantically identical; dependency: stdlib os/contextlib only; concurrency: cross-process via lock file, single-threaded per process (documented); state: stale-lock break by mtime can break a live >30s writer - documented, bounded
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first tests (lock refusal, stale break, recovery after release, error-path release); suite + strict check; ADR-010 before commit; validate commit subject
